delay_seconds.description: Delay in seconds (0 for real-time/sim, None if delayed but unknown).
delay_seconds.title: Delay Seconds

feed_mode.description: Origin regime: SIMULATED (walk), REPLAY (history), or LIVE (market feed).

ingested_at.description: UTC timestamp when the quote was received at the ingestion boundary.
ingested_at.title: Ingested At

is_delayed.description: True if the market quote is subject to an exchange dissemination delay.
is_delayed.title: Is Delayed

DataProvenance.title: DataProvenance

Direction.description: Directional bias of a technical or quantitative trading signal.
Direction.title: Direction

FeedMode.description: Canonical market data feed modes across configuration and payload contracts.
FeedMode.title: FeedMode

MarketRegime.description: Classified market volatility and trend regime for an NSE instrument.
MarketRegime.title: MarketRegime

description: Output of MCP Server 2 (Technical Analyst) and the Analyst Agent.

confidence.description: Deterministic rule-agreement ratio quantized to 0.01: count(rules_in_direction) / (count(rules_long) + count(rules_short)). Equals Decimal('0.50') on tied FLAT signals.
confidence.title: Confidence

config_hash.description: SHA-256 (64 hex characters) of the active technical rules configuration.
config_hash.title: Config Hash

indicators.description: Named indicator values (e.g. ema_9, ema_21, rsi_14, atr_14, vwap).
indicators.title: Indicators

provenance.description: Propagated input data provenance holding provider, feed_mode, is_delayed, delay_seconds, and ingested_at. Required for schema >= 1.2.0.

regime.description: Classified volatility/trend regime, or None if regime classifier is unready or disabled.

rules_long.description: Deterministic rule names that fired for LONG direction.
rules_long.title: Rules Long

rules_short.description: Deterministic rule names that fired for SHORT direction.
rules_short.title: Rules Short
